fields.name: event
fields.description: first, observed (a new value), reset (window rolled over: 100% left) or early_reset (use dropped before the reset time: a reset credit or provider reset)

fields.name: account
fields.description: Account key: a short hash, never the e-mail address

fields.name: subscription
fields.description: Subscription name: Claude Ultra, ChatGPT Pro 100, ...

fields.description: claudeAgent, codex, ...

fields.description: Window length in minutes (10080 = a week)

fields.name: used_percent
fields.description: Percent of the window used

fields.name: left_percent
fields.description: Percent of the window left

fields.name: resets_at
fields.description: When the window resets

fields.name: window_start
fields.description: When the current window began

fields.name: time_left_hours
fields.description: Hours left in the window at this status

fields.name: time_left
fields.description: Time left in the window, e.g. 3d 7h

fields.name: window_elapsed_percent
fields.description: Percent of the window's time already past

fields.name: pace_points
fields.description: used_percent minus window_elapsed_percent: above 0 burns faster than an even pace

fields.name: projected_used_at_reset
fields.description: used_percent extrapolated to the reset at this pace

fields.name: burn_since_previous
fields.description: New percentage points used since the previous status: only a rise above this window cycle's high-water mark counts, so jittering snapshots never double count; sum it per week for the burn-down

fields.name: hours_since_previous
fields.description: Hours since the previous status of this window

fields.name: cycle_burn_per_day
fields.description: Average percentage points used per day since the window began

fields.name: used_before_reset
fields.description: On a reset: percent used just before it

fields.name: status
fields.description: Provider status: allowed, allowed_warning, rejected

fields.name: plan_type
fields.description: Provider plan type when the source names it

fields.name: source
fields.description: t3_cache, t3_provider_log, codex_session or reset_time
